query: What's the right way to notify the PWD about a canal leakage?
reference_answer:
Reporting Canal Breaches to PWD:
To report a canal breach, contact the nearest PWD office or call the PWD helpline immediately. Provide details of the breach, location, and your contact information. You can also report online through the PWD website or mobile app.
answer: To notify the Public Works Department (PWD) about a canal leakage, contact their hotline or visit their website for an online form. Include details like the location and extent of the leak. [Document 1]
